rows.question: For one quality objective, what will be done to achieve it?
For one quality objective, what resources will be required?
For one quality objective, who is responsible for achieving it?
For one quality objective, when is it due to be completed?
For one quality objective, how will the results be evaluated?
For a planned QMS change, what is its purpose and what are its potential consequences?
evidence: Change plan with purpose and consequences

rows.question: For a planned QMS change, how is the integrity of the QMS protected?
For a planned QMS change, what resources are available to carry it out?
For a planned QMS change, how are responsibilities and authorities allocated or reallocated?
evidence: Responsibility and authority record for the change

rows.question: For a planned QMS change, what risks arise during the transition period, and what mitigation actions were planned?
What are your internal resource capabilities and constraints, and how did you assess them?
What resources are obtained from external providers, and how are they controlled?
For one maintenance task, were tools, equipment, maintenance data, facilities, materials and qualified persons available when the task was performed?
evidence: Current maintenance data at point of work

rows.question: What buildings and utilities are needed for your processes, and how are they maintained?
What equipment, hardware and software do your processes need, and how is it maintained?
What transportation resources are needed, and how are they managed?
What information and communication technology supports your processes, and how is it kept available?
How are serviceable and unserviceable articles, and aviation and non-aviation products, segregated? Show the arrangement.
evidence: Segregation arrangement with a physical check

rows.question: What social environment conditions matter to your maintenance processes, and how are they set?
What psychological conditions matter to your processes, and how are they supported?
What physical conditions (temperature, humidity, light, airflow, cleanliness, noise) matter to your processes, and how are they monitored?
For one monitoring or measuring resource, show that it suits the specific activity it is used for.
Show the documented evidence that a measuring resource remains fit for its purpose.
Pick a calibrated instrument. Show its calibration at the set interval against a traceable standard. Where no standard exists, what basis was used?
evidence: Calibration certificate traceable to national or international standards
Recorded basis where no standard exists

rows.question: How is the calibration status of each instrument identified? Show it on one instrument.
How is an instrument safeguarded from adjustment or damage? Show the recall process, the register entry, and what was reviewed when an instrument was found out of tolerance.
evidence: Register entry with type, ID, location, method, frequency and acceptance criteria
Review of past results after an out-of-tolerance finding

rows.question: What internal knowledge is critical to your processes, and how is it captured and shared?
What external knowledge sources do you use to keep critical knowledge current?
For one role that affects the QMS or maintenance, what competence is required?
How do you confirm a person in that role is competent, on the basis of education, training or experience?
evidence: Training or qualification records for the person

rows.question: When competence was lacking, what action was taken, and how was its effectiveness evaluated?
Where is the documented evidence of competence kept?
evidence: Competence records in a controlled location

rows.question: How are persons doing maintenance identified, qualified and certified in line with the competent authority's requirements? Show a certifying staff member's authorization.
evidence: Certification record per the competent authority

rows.question: How are initial and recurrent training and assessment programmes run, so that maintenance staff, including certifying staff, stay current in procedures, human factors, technical knowledge and on-the-job training?
Where is the documented information on persons performing maintenance, as the competent authority requires?
evidence: Documented information on persons performing maintenance

rows.question: Before a non-qualified person does unsupervised work, how is their ability to understand maintenance data and carry out tasks assessed? Show the surveillance record.
evidence: Surveillance and assessment record for a non-qualified person

rows.question: Can a staff member tell you what the quality policy says?
Can a staff member tell you the quality objectives relevant to their work?
Can a staff member explain their contribution to QMS effectiveness and the benefit of improved performance?
Can a staff member explain the implications of not conforming to QMS requirements?
How are staff told about relevant QMS documents and the changes made to them?
Can a staff member explain their contribution to product or service conformity?
Can a staff member explain their contribution to product safety?
How is the importance of ethical behaviour communicated to staff?
Can a staff member describe the safety policy and the safety objectives related to the product?
Can a technician describe how human factors could affect the maintenance tasks they perform?
What does the organization communicate, internally and externally, about the QMS?
When does the organization communicate each QMS item?
With whom does the organization communicate, and how is that decided?
How does the organization communicate: which channels and methods?
Who is responsible for each communication, and how is product safety information promoted to staff?
Show the documented information the standard requires, against the standard's list.
What other documented information has the organization decided is needed for QMS effectiveness, and why?
What documented information has the organization decided is needed for effective product safety management?
Pick a controlled document. Does it show identification and description: title, date, author or reference number?
Does the document show a suitable format and media, and where relevant the software version?
Who reviewed and approved this document for suitability and adequacy, and are those approvers authorized?
Can the people who need this controlled document reach a current copy, and is it usable where the work happens? Show the point of use.
How do you guard this document against unauthorised disclosure, misuse or corruption?
evidence: Protection controls such as permissions and backups
